source_diff.candidate_delta: One payload-owned flag/helper, noncoherent payload allocation/free, full-allocation bidirectional synchronization, ownership rejection guard and descriptive metadata. Coherent descriptor allocation/free unchanged.

API_review: dma-api.rst:582-585 requires sync_for_device even before first device use, and sync_for_cpu before CPU reads device data.

dma_alloc_noncoherent wraps dma_alloc_pages/page_address. In this direct ARM64 path dma_direct_alloc_pages returns CPU-owned zeroed page_address memory without a device ownership transfer or coherent remap.
Identical device/handle/65536-byte size/DMA_BIDIRECTIONAL are used for alloc, both sync directions and free. mmc_dev(host->mmc) is the original parent device.
ARM64 sync_device cleans to PoC; sync_cpu for BIDIRECTIONAL invalidates to PoC. Entire allocation maintenance covers CPU-written tuning poison and dirty cache-line tails of small transfers.
Existing32-bit coherent and streaming masks apply to allocation. No DT dma-coherent override, raw physical map, private PTE change or alias introduced.
ownership_review: CPU-owned initially. command rejects dead or device-owned state before any tuning poison; original128/512 poison retained.

All pre-start threshold/descriptor/short-write-copy failures remain before handoff. Successful sync_for_device precedes unchanged dma_wmb and MMIO enable; no fallible early-return occurs between handoff and command mandatory stop.
Central stop reclaims only after all three hardware reset fences succeeded. Command-error payloads are reclaimed before the next operation, without copying failed data to SG.
Any reset failure sets dma_dead and ios_error, skips cache synchronization and SG readback, and leaves both allocations quarantined. Subsequent commands and remove cannot touch or free the payload.
Probe early allocation cleanup is CPU-owned; successful remove first stops/reclaims then frees exact allocations. Descriptor snapshots may inspect coherent descriptor state but never payload.

tests_review.author_recorded_execution: Separate CPU-cache/device-memory model, -Wall -Wextra -Werror, ASan/UBSan PASS; ARM64 external-module build against v25 PASS. Reviewer inspected exact test/source/log bindings and model assertions, without rerunning physical operations.
tests_review.covered: first and duplicate handoff;128/512 repeated poison defeating stale success;64KiB write/read;4B dirty-tail full synchronization;all3pre+3post reset failure positions;dead-state access/free rejection;short-write-copy failure;ordinary/tuning command errors then fresh poison;remove reclaim/free
tests_review.not_covered: Physical cache hardware behavior, actual DMA completion, real memory ordering, full system behavior or performance.

measurement_review: read_copy still measures SG copy only. dma_start adds sync_device; post_reset adds sync_cpu, so post_reset is no longer pure reset cost.
Pre-reset can include recovery sync if ownership remained outstanding; ordinary completed request flow has already reclaimed.
Nested service/start/pre-reset/callback totals cannot be summed. Wall times include scheduling/interrupts.
dispatch crosses submitter/worker contexts; only single-worker segments permit the different-CPU-endpoint migration inference. Same endpoints do not establish residency.
